gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link XXHash32}, the xxHash32 checksum implementation.

The expected hash values below are the algorithm's deterministic output for the given seed
ADDED i3: Hash of an empty/unmodified stream with seed 0.
ADDED i4: Updating with a zero-length slice leaves the checksum unchanged, so the value equals that of an empty stream.
ADDED i5: len = 0, so no bytes are consumed regardless of the offset.
ADDED i6: Feeding a single zero byte produces the expected hash for seed 0.
ADDED i7: Feeding four individual bytes (13, 13, 0, 0) accumulates into one hash.
ADDED i8: The no-arg constructor uses seed 0, matching an explicit seed of 0.
ADDED i9: reset() on a freshly created instance restores the initial hash value.
ADDED i10: A single byte followed by a 16-byte array slice produces the expected hash.
ADDED i11: Hashing the first 16 bytes of a zero-filled array fills exactly one block.
